source_sync.preserved_differences: Six existing documents retain their independent history and UMC references; only feature hunks applied
source_sync.timing: Feature sources synchronized before final delivery documentation; six independent document histories preserved

visual_review.scope: Eight manually inspected images: clock fixture and installed release clock tab on Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04, Rocky Linux 8 and Rocky Linux 10
observations: All eight information rows, three complete raw register words and the bottom interpretation fit on all four inspected fixture pages
Synthetic BCLK is 101250 kHz; the historical MRC request shows Gear 2, 100 MHz reference steps, encoded QCLK ratio 32 and VDDQ TX 1150 mV
IccMax remains encoded 9 and its current conversion is marked unconfirmed; current memory frequency is explicitly Unavailable
Heading and footer distinguish the last MRC request from current memory speed, live Gear and measured rail voltage
Installed release pages show the Clock information tab with read/open controls, empty tables and disabled Copy/Save buttons
The larger EL10 font geometry preserves the final row and footer without clipping

superseded_attempts.reason: GUI lifecycle regression used dot member access on a pointer; compile failure fixed in b3a40d7. Final evidence uses the corrected commit only.

limits: Live reads require CPUID Intel family 6 model B7 without a hypervisor, PCI 8086:A700 class 060000 and an already enabled MCHBAR
Shared PCU registers use no controller/channel stride; MRC requests do not establish current memory frequency, live Gear or measured VDDQ voltage
Two matching snapshots detect changes but are not atomic hardware measurements; all fixture values are synthetic
IccMax is an encoded value only because the primary-source example conflicts with its bit width; no writes are implemented by this feature
Other AMD, Intel and board-specific protocols, target hardware and Secure Boot validation remain pending
Portable core validation on Windows/macOS is not a full hardware port

source_research.manual: Intel 743846-001, Rev 001, October 2022; desktop Raptor Lake-S
source_research.findings: MC_BIOS_DATA is the last MRC request, not current memory frequency; BCLK_FREQ low 32 bits report kHz; IccMax example conflicts with its four-bit width
